title.zh: Bitget had 30 minutes to contain its hack before $290 million started moving
title.en: Bitget had 30 minutes to contain its hack before $290 million started moving

current_state.zh: Bitget detected unauthorized wallet transfers about 30 minutes before attackers drained $87.6 million and then $202.8 million from its hot wallets, meaning most of the $387.5 million loss occurred after the exchange's emergency protocols were triggered and raising questions about why the compromised signing route stayed live.
